# Swordsmanship

**Tags:** `skill`

Mastery of bladed weapons — from crude ferrite daggers to enchanted veilsteel longswords. Covers footwork, swing mechanics, and dueling composure.

> **Goal:** Gate melee combat power behind practiced investment
